title: metadata-protocol: after a package is uninstalled, its orphaned package-unbound customization surfaces as a standalone environment item — measure the full uninstall door, then decide
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ② measure-first finding from the read-only analysis behind #34348 · Child of topic #36229.

Triage: lands in area:package · domain:server · Task · priority:p3 · `pm:queue` · size S; rationale: under the #33401 ruling's second arm, a package-unbound row at a name no installed package holds is the environment's own item. So once a package is **uninstalled**, an old customization of one of its items becomes a visible standalone item, which is arguably wrong under the maintainer's 「停用就该全部消失」. Only a registry-level uninstall was measured (bare read and list serve the row, 200), not the real uninstall door. Measure first; the maintainer decides only once the reading is in.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：一个包卸载后，管理员以前对它某个内容做的定制，可能会变成一个独立的内容重新出现。
- 先做：用真实的卸载流程实测一次，确认它是否会出现、出现后能不能用。
- 需要你做的：实测结果出来后再决定这条定制该删掉、隐藏还是保留。

## Measure
On `main`, install a package that ships a dashboard, write a package-unbound customization of it (or lay a legacy row), then uninstall the package through the real door (`DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id` or `os package uninstall`). Report what the bare read, list, `_env` and `/layers` serve, and whether the uninstall capture (#34291's family) records the row. Report on this card; do not change behaviour.

Blocked-by: none.
